title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A fierce female warrior with purple hair stands in a dynamic combat stance, wielding a massive purple hammer crackling with bright purple lightning and energy. She wears a white and purple cropped armored outfit with matching leg guards and boots against a solid dark gray background.
prompt: A fierce young woman with short purple hair in a dynamic combat stance, powerfully swinging a huge ornate purple warhammer that is exploding with bright purple electrical energy and lightning. She wears a white and purple cropped armored top with matching pants, leg wraps and boots. Solid dark gray background, clean digital illustration style, strong lighting, vibrant purple energy effects.
